svg.title: Known-best packing of 260 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=260 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 0075967 rational centre/half-angle certificate of a display-regularized view of a record packing solved to its exact side, converted exactly from the retained source. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, same-packing, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.
